name: LIB-RB-01 — Per-track waveform previews in library
description:
HTML202 implemented; user visual approval pending. Preview column contains each track's actual full-track decoded-source RGB waveform; no repeated decorative fixtures. Queued/preparing/unavailable-retry states, sequential visible-row jobs, local PNG cache, content-based local-track identity, and persisted show/hide in existing Columns dialog. Other layout variants preserve their existing columns. No native build or production engine/MIDI/source renderer change.

Executed normal HTML UI: ten rendered row previews including two original local MP3s; two different visible waveforms with loaded320px image data; sort reverses order while preserving trackID→same image; search retains correct association; header/row cell counts match; hide/show; hidden preference survives reload; thumbnails reload from local-cache; paused deck titles/timers unchanged during these actions; four-deck switch preserves thumbnails and Hybrid hides this new column. These establish thumbnail behavior, not playback quality or full rekordbox parity.

Unexecuted: corrupt/missing-file retry, blocked-storage fallback, large-library endurance. Preview audition/seek is outside this static-thumbnail unit and requires separate native behavior evidence. Docs: docs/prototype/LIBRARY_WAVEFORMS_202.md/.json; private screenshot/DOM receipts in local-evidence/library-waveforms-202/. Related ANA-001, LIB-003 and UI-001. Native approval gate remains.

Models: Codex gpt-6.1-sol high; Claude Code Sonnet5 medium, verify live availability. Escalate reasoning for reproducible stale association, audio mutation or unbounded preparation bugs; reviewer exercises actual UI above. No agents launched.
